<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Whats That up Your Sleeve?](/Feats.aspx?ID=4168) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="General" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=78" />
<trait label="Skill" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=144" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 73

**Prerequisites**
Expert in [Gambling Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8)

</column>

---

Whether as a dealer or player, you've learned to spot cheaters. When another creature attempts to [Conceal an Object](/Actions.aspx?ID=61) from you, use your Gambling Lore DC if it's higher than your Perception DC to determine whether they succeed. When you search a creature for a concealed object, you can use Gambling Lore in place of Perception.
name: Whats That up Your Sleeve?
